name: EUR/USD 1.10 Level Breakout Study
description: Research study analyzing EUR/USD around the 1.10 price level over the past 2 years. Measures how often price closes above 1.10, detects breakout events (first close above 1.10 from below), and analyzes the 20-day forward return path after each breakout — including whether price holds above 1.10 or fades back below.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD 1.10 PRICE LEVEL BREAKOUT STUDY
# =============================================================================
# Question 1: How often has EUR/USD closed above 1.10?
# Question 2: When price breaks OUT above 1.10 (crossover), what do the next
#             20 days look like? Does it hold or fade?
# Event: Previous close <= 1.10 AND current close > 1.10 (crossover)
# Forward window: 5, 10, 20 trading days
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# LEVEL ANALYSIS — How often above 1.10?
# =============================================================================

LEVEL = 1.10

is_above = close > LEVEL

# Count helpers: 1.0 on every valid bar, 1.0 on above bars
bar_count = 1.0 if is_valid(close) else 0.0
above_count = 1.0 if is_above else 0.0

# Fraction of days above (for the summary table % metric)
# We'll use cumulative counts and take the ratio via Mean aggregation on above_count
# (Mean of 0/1 series = hit rate = % of days above)

# =============================================================================
# BREAKOUT DETECTION — crossover: prev close <= 1.10, current close > 1.10
# =============================================================================

is_breakout = crossover(close, LEVEL)

# Breakout event counter (for summary table)
breakout_count = 1.0 if is_breakout else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD PRICES & RETURNS AFTER BREAKOUT
# =============================================================================

# Forward prices at +5, +10, +20 bars
price_5d  = close << 5
price_10d = close << 10
price_20d = close << 20

# Forward returns from breakout close
ret_5d  = (price_5d  - close) / close
ret_10d = (price_10d - close) / close
ret_20d = (price_20d - close) / close

# Did price hold above 1.10 at day +20? (1.0 = yes, 0.0 = no)
held_20d = 1.0 if price_20d > LEVEL else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# BREAKOUT-FILTERED SERIES (sparse — non-null only on breakout bars)
# =============================================================================

ev_close    = where(is_breakout, close)
ev_price_5d = where(is_breakout, price_5d)
ev_price_10d= where(is_breakout, price_10d)
ev_price_20d= where(is_breakout, price_20d)
ev_ret_5d   = where(is_breakout, ret_5d)
ev_ret_10d  = where(is_breakout, ret_10d)
ev_ret_20d  = where(is_breakout, ret_20d)
ev_held_20d = where(is_breakout, held_20d)

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURN PATH (running total across breakout events, chronological)
# Each step = one breakout event's +20d outcome
# =============================================================================

# Zero-fill non-breakout bars so cumulative() accumulates only on event bars
ret_20d_clean = ret_20d if is_breakout else 0.0
ret_20d_clean2 = ret_20d_clean if is_valid(ret_20d_clean) else 0.0
cum_ret_20d = cumulative()(ret_20d_clean2)

# Also track cumulative +5d and +10d paths for richer chart
ret_5d_clean  = ret_5d  if is_breakout else 0.0
ret_5d_clean2 = ret_5d_clean  if is_valid(ret_5d_clean)  else 0.0
cum_ret_5d = cumulative()(ret_5d_clean2)

ret_10d_clean  = ret_10d  if is_breakout else 0.0
ret_10d_clean2 = ret_10d_clean  if is_valid(ret_10d_clean)  else 0.0
cum_ret_10d = cumulative()(ret_10d_clean2)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table 1: Overall Level Statistics ---
# Rows: one summary row
# Cols: Total Days | Days Above 1.10 | % Days Above | Breakout Events
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EUR/USD 1.10 Level — Summary Statistics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['EUR/USD vs 1.10'],
        col_headers=['Total Trading Days', 'Days Closed Above 1.10', '% of Days Above 1.10', 'Breakout Events Detected'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Amber)
        ]
    ),
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Study',
    order=0
)(bar_count, above_count, above_count, breakout_count)

# --- Chart 1: EUR/USD Close Price with 1.10 Reference Line ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Close Price vs 1.10 Level',
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Study',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.10, title='1.10 Level', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, close)

# --- Chart 2: Cumulative +20d Return Path Across All Breakout Events ---
# Each step in the line = one breakout event's forward outcome added to the running total
# Rising line = breakouts tend to hold / produce positive returns
# Flat/falling line = breakouts tend to fade
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Forward Returns After 1.10 Breakouts (Chronological)',
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Study',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+5d Return', color=Color.Sky,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+10d Return', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+20d Return', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(idx, cum_ret_5d, cum_ret_10d, cum_ret_20d)

# --- Table 2: Breakout Event Outcomes — Avg Return & Hold Rate by Horizon ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Event Outcomes by Horizon',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['All Breakouts'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg +5d Return', 'Avg +10d Return', 'Avg +20d Return', '% Held Above 1.10 at +20d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Study',
    order=3
)(ev_ret_5d, ev_ret_5d, ev_ret_10d, ev_ret_20d, ev_held_20d)

# --- Event Markers: Per-Breakout Detail Cards ---
# Shows date, close at breakout, forward prices at +5/+10/+20, and held flag
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EUR/USD 1.10 Breakout',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,    title='Close at Breakout',    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Price at +5d',         type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Price at +10d',        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Price at +20d',        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Return',          type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Held Above 1.10 @+20d', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout, ev_close, ev_price_5d, ev_price_10d, ev_price_20d, ev_ret_20d, ev_held_20d)
